highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and expanded platform support.
highlights_body: The v4 preview line adds color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, zero-copy stream access, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. It also fixes Android typeface initialization, Android GL view reattachment, and an SKPath finalizer crash.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The Skia m147 update drops the EOL Tizen arm and x86 native builds. Move Tizen deployments to the new `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` assets before upgrading.

breaking.title: WASM native assets now require .NET 8 or later
breaking.body: Native assets for Emscripten versions older than 3.1.34 are removed. Blazor WASM and Uno Platform WASM projects targeting .NET 6 or .NET 7 now receive a build error; retarget them to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: The Vulkan YCbCr conversion info struct now follows the SkiaSharp `GR` casing convention. Update references to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`; the old type no longer provides its IEquatable, Equals, or equality operators.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside the 32-bit native range
breaking.body: The legacy `SKStream.Move(long)` overload now uses a checked conversion and throws `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating large offsets. Keep offsets within the 32-bit range and migrate away from the obsolete overload.

breaking.title: Assembly version advances to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks when adopting the v4 preview.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m119 to m147
bullets.detail: The bundled engine spans the m132 and m133 updates through m147, bringing codec orientation, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, CICP color spaces, newer filters, and accumulated rendering fixes.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp can query variation axes, clone typefaces at design coordinates, select built-in palettes, and override individual palette colors.
`SKWebpEncoder` adds single-frame and animated encoding overloads, with frame durations represented by `SKWebpEncoderFrame`.
`SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` gain `SKSamplingOptions` overloads for choosing filtering and mipmap behavior.

bullets.lead: Zero-copy access to memory-backed stream data
bullets.detail: `SKStream.GetData()` returns the backing `SKData` when the native stream can expose it cheaply.

bullets.lead: New document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs
bullets.detail: Adds `SKDocument.CreateXps`, per-resource `GRContext.Flush`, `SKMaskFilter.CreateShader`, `SKColorSpace.CreateCicp`, HDR color types, and the correctly ordered `HBColor` value type.
Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font-manager path, avoiding Android API 36 startup crashes and returning an empty typeface as a safe last resort.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer races its builder
bullets.detail: Disposal no longer flushes a collected `SKPathBuilder`, preventing a finalizer-thread native crash.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView survives navigation and tab switches
bullets.detail: Reattached GL views retain their current dimensions instead of recreating a zero-sized surface.

bullets.lead: Font and stream edge cases corrected
bullets.detail: Undersized variable-font spans now follow their documented write counts, glyph checks avoid infinite recursion, and negative stream moves retain the correct native value.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic assets for x64 and arm64
bullets.detail: Dedicated `linux-bionic` runtime assets support Android-hosted Linux environments for both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp.
Adds official `tizen-x64` and `tizen-arm64` package assets while the Skia m147 transition retires 32-bit Tizen builds.

bullets.lead: Apple libraries target the base 26.0 SDK
bullets.detail: Versioned library TFMs use 26.0 for broader Xcode 26 compatibility, while apps use unversioned Apple TFMs.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia m132 and m147 updates, variable fonts, managed default typefaces, the SKPath finalizer fix, and Uno sample improvements

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Moves the assembly to v4 and Skia to m147, removes 32-bit Tizen assets, and makes oversized `SKStream.Move` offsets fail explicitly. Adds variable fonts, color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, CICP color spaces, Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets, while fixing Android default typefaces and SKGLView reattachment.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and zero-copy access to memory-backed stream data, fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and broadens Apple SDK compatibility.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Requires .NET 8 or later for WASM native assets and renames `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. Adds `HBColor`, XPS creation, per-resource GPU flushes, shader mask filters, refreshes bundled native libraries, and prevents NanoServer font-manager crashes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces `HBColor` for correct `hb_color_t` channel ordering, and gains Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets.
